## 更新内容 / Changes

- 简化实例创建：Codex API 密钥自动通过管理器转发，ChatGPT 账号默认原生登录；普通流程不再要求选择「直连 API / 本地 API」。Claude 保留已有原生连接与客户端内登录方式。
- 将 Codex API 的「绕过管理器 API 转发」收进高级连接设置，默认关闭，并说明 Responses 协议、调用记录与网络代理的边界。ChatGPT 账号请求转发也移入高级设置。
- 已有实例和复制草稿保留原接入方式。旧直连实例可停止后编辑，明确关闭绕过并保存；取消或普通改名不会迁移连接。账号、模型、实例目录、会话与网络代理设置保持各自边界。
- 按凭据类型分别保存当前草稿的高级选择，避免在官方账号与 API 密钥之间切换时沿用错误路径。不兼容的直连协议会引导打开高级设置。

- Simplifies instance creation: Codex API keys automatically use manager forwarding and ChatGPT accounts default to native sign-in. The ordinary flow no longer asks users to choose direct versus local API. Existing Claude native connections and in-client sign-in remain available.
- Moves Codex API forwarding bypass into Advanced connection settings, off by default, with clear Responses, call-history and network-proxy boundaries. ChatGPT account forwarding is also an advanced option.
- Preserves existing and copied instance modes. Stop a direct instance, edit its advanced settings, turn bypass off and save to switch deliberately. Canceling or renaming does not migrate its connection; accounts, models, instance directories, sessions and proxy settings retain their separate roles.
- Keeps draft overrides separate for API keys and official accounts, so changing credential families selects the appropriate route. Incompatible direct protocols lead back to the advanced setting.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。账号、实例、会话及本地配置保留。运行实例结束且管理器完全退出后再切换新版；普通退出可能保留后台服务。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证；Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Accounts, instances, sessions and settings are retained. Switch versions after active instances finish and the manager exits completely; ordinary Quit may retain background services. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

支持 Codex 桌面 / CLI、macOS Claude Desktop 独立实例的客户端内登录或 API / 第三方连接，以及 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI 的 API Key、Bearer 和订阅 OAuth 连接；客户端需单独安装。官方 Codex 账号原生桌面使用原版界面；API 菜单和语言兼容取决于客户端能力，Fast / Ultra 还取决于模型与服务商。

Claude Desktop 分别保存实例 Cookie、配置与本地历史，共用当前 macOS 用户的系统钥匙串；同账号云端历史仍可同步。Claude Code 本地会话支持浏览，停止的受管 CLI 实例支持预览后继续；Desktop 的 Chat、Cowork、远程记录与继续对话由原客户端管理。

Supports Codex desktop / CLI, independent macOS Claude Desktop instances with in-client sign-in or API / third-party connections, and the official native macOS Claude Code CLI with API Key, Bearer or subscription OAuth connections. Install clients separately. Native Codex account desktop instances use the original UI; API menu and language compatibility depends on the client, while Fast / Ultra also depends on the model and provider.

Claude Desktop instances isolate cookies, configuration and local history while sharing the current macOS user's Keychain; cloud history for the same account may still sync. Local Claude Code transcripts can be browsed and stopped managed CLI instances resumed after a preview. Manage Desktop Chat, Cowork, remote records and continued conversations in the original client.

## 验证来源 / Verification

验证范围包括新建默认值、按凭据类型切换、旧实例编辑和复制、取消与保存、网络代理独立性，以及 Claude 原有连接流程。真实管理器界面使用隔离数据、合成账号与本机模拟服务，覆盖高级设置的展开、操作反馈和滚动显示。回归包含 TypeScript、Go、管理器界面和 macOS arm64 打包验收；不使用真实账号或付费模型，不声明本轮重新验证官方客户端的真实登录或上游能力。

Verification covers creation defaults, credential-family changes, editing and copying legacy instances, cancellation and saving, independent proxy settings, and existing Claude connection flows. The actual manager UI uses isolated data, synthetic accounts and loopback fixtures to check advanced controls, feedback and scrolling. Regression checks include TypeScript, Go, manager UI and macOS arm64 packaged-app acceptance. No real accounts or paid models are used; this release does not claim renewed official-client sign-in or upstream feature validation.
